testcase.name: a stored package the engine refuses is dropped and not served again
every fixed package has its own key and fingerprint
packages are baked for OpenGL and Vulkan
the fixed set adds both catcher paths and their bake passes
the base set is lit x3, unlit x3 and the trail, in bind order
the fingerprint follows every builder input
a variant key carries extension flags, bound slots and the API
bound slots and extension flags change the package
a package that did not come from the store cannot be rejected
the fingerprint is stable for equal inputs
the fingerprint follows the Filament version
